verdict.rationale: Plausible offers scheduled email/Slack reports (subscribe to dashboard) and explicit 'traffic spike notifications' that alert when traffic moves abnormally, directly matching the core of this story. However, evidence only covers traffic volume anomalies, not configurable alerts on other key metrics like conversion rate, revenue, or goal completions, and there's no mention of custom thresholds or anomaly sensitivity settings. Missing for 10: alerting on arbitrary/custom key metrics beyond traffic, threshold configuration, and real-time push alerts (vs. periodic email/Slack digests).
